content.jointProblem: Can GenovaMed and Rakić jointly profile and re-engineer the Python/Snakemake short-read star-allele calling pipeline so that cloud compute drops from about 9 EUR to below 3 EUR per sample and a 24-sample batch runs in under 90 minutes while allele calls remain clinically concordant?

rationale.text: Rakić has a track record of reducing per-sample cloud spend in a health-tech WES pipeline.

sources.quote: reducing their per-sample cloud spend by approximately 35 %

rationale.text: He has built cost models and checkpointing strategies for spot-instance genomic pipelines.

sources.quote: A bidding and checkpoint strategy derived from the model reduced pipeline cost by 41 % on average relative to on-demand in stable price periods.

rationale.text: He has direct experience optimising short-read alignment throughput on multicore systems.

sources.quote: 22 % wall-clock speedup compared to the reference implementation at equivalent accuracy

rationale.text: He has hands-on Snakemake/SLURM scatter-gather execution experience for clinical WES cohorts.

sources.quote: Job orchestration used Snakemake with a SLURM backend.

rationale.text: His project work includes cloud-cost-aware orchestration between on-premises HPC and spot-instance cloud execution.

sources.quote: cloud-cost-aware orchestration layer that dynamically selects between on-premises HPC and spot-instance cloud execution depending on queue state, sample priority, and real-time cloud pricing

constraints.text: Any optimisation must preserve the clinical accuracy of the star-allele calls.

sources.quote: without touching the clinical accuracy of the calls

constraints.text: The target outcome is compute cost below 3 EUR per sample and ideally total run time under 90 minutes.

sources.quote: getting compute cost below 3 EUR per sample and ideally cutting total run time to under 90 minutes

constraints.text: The pipeline to be optimised is the in-house Python/Snakemake star-allele caller running on cloud VMs.

sources.quote: In-house star-allele calling pipeline (Python, Snakemake) running on cloud VMs

constraints.text: Changes must fit within the ISO 15189 accredited quality management system.
Work must use retained clinical samples held under ethics approval and stay within the small discretionary R&D budget.

sources.quote: access to the in-house sequencer, a set of retained clinical samples held under ethics approval, and a small discretionary R&D budget of approximately 8,000 EUR per year

constraints.text: The two-person bioinformatics team and two senior molecular biologists can dedicate roughly two days per week each.

sources.quote: The two-person bioinformatics team and two senior molecular biologists can dedicate roughly two days per week each

risks: The published speedups are for WGS/WES alignment and GATK HaplotypeCaller, not targeted CYP2C19/CYP2D6 star-allele calling; the transfer to GenovaMed's pipeline must be tested first.
Naive spot-instance use could increase rather than decrease cost if checkpointing is not implemented.
Any speedup that changes allele calls would fail the clinical accuracy and ISO 15189 requirements.
Rakić's availability for a joint project is marked unknown in the participation data; scheduling and capacity could fail if it is not confirmed.
The company's limited R&D budget and staff time may constrain how much cloud experimentation and pipeline integration can be done.
questions: Can Boris Rakić confirm his availability and weekly capacity for a joint project?
What are the exact pipeline stages, tools, cloud provider, instance types, and current per-stage profiling data at GenovaMed?
What validated truth set or reference allele calls can be used to verify that optimisation does not change clinical accuracy?
What ISO 15189 re-validation steps and acceptance thresholds, such as concordance, must any pipeline change pass?
Are the below-3-EUR-per-sample and under-90-minute targets hard requirements or aspirational, and is the 90-minute target for a 24-sample batch?
How will ethics approval, data protection, and cloud data residency constrain use of retained clinical samples?
Given unknown willingness, is there any interest in an industrial PhD hosting route in addition to a joint project?
